take_homes: Name a framework and tune it ('apply X to Y, tuned for Z') instead of describing it. It's cheap and works.
Start a fresh independent critic with only the output as context. An agent grading its own work in the same session goes easy on itself.
A rules file the agent reads every session is the thing to roll out to non-engineers. Specific input (my gripes, my facts) beats generic input.

monday.move: Draft a CLAUDE.md-style rules file for the sales team's proposals. Run the cold-critic step on one real proposal.

misconception.why: Seeing the agent go soft on its own site made me see that a good agent can still give a flattering review. I'm not convinced checking is needed for everything, and I still skipped most review steps today.

one_line: Nice for people new to agents. For me it was mostly the dinner example, but the cold-critic trick and the hate-list inversion were worth the time.
